system.description:
Prerequisites: Intermediate Auspex, Basic Chimerstry. Reveals a target's greatest desire and manifests an illusory physical token of it, a potent tool for manipulation.

System: The Ravnos spends one Blood Point and one Willpower, then rolls Intelligence + Subterfuge (difficulty equal to the target's Willpower); three successes are needed to discover the desire. Once discovered, the token can be recreated at will for the same cost, unless the target's desire changes.

Costs 20 experience points (dot system) / 10 Experience Traits (MET) to learn.

MET: The Ravnos spends one Blood Trait and one Willpower Trait and wins a Mental Challenge against the target to discover the desire; thereafter she may recreate the illusion at will using a standard Fata Morgana.
